title: Global genetic diversity, introgression, and evolutionary adaptation of indicine cattle revealed by whole genome sequencing

passages.quote: Archaeological evidence indicates the presence of domesticated indicine cattle earlier in the Indus Valley (~8000 YBP) than in South India (~5000 YBP) and the middle Ganges (~4000 YBP)
The global dispersal of indicine cattle started in the Indus Valley at ~5000 YBP, followed by their spread into Southwest and Central Asia, East Asia, and Africa between 4000 and 1300 YBP
